summary: SSRF prevention: Ollama URL validated at startup (whitelist), reqwest redirect(Policy::none()) prevents redirect-based SSRF (Decision 8). Rate limiting: governor keyed by IP, 10 req/min. Input validation: message length capped at 2000 chars, empty/missing rejected with 400. User query delimited with [USER_QUERY]...[/USER_QUERY] tags (Decision 10). No user input concatenated into URLs. Error responses use structured JSON without leaking internal details. Download handler validates path existence before serving.
